verses.text: Ayik 23 ab'il yoch winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Ocozías reyal t'a Judá, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Joacaz yuninal winhaj Jehú yak'an reyal t'a Israel. 17 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha juntzanh chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annak heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, a chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh.
Yuj wal chi' ix kot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová t'a heb' israel chi', niwan tiempo ix kan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Hazael sreyal Siria yet' pax t'a yol sk'ab' winh yuninal winh, haton winhaj Ben-adad.
Yuj chi' ix lesalwi winhaj Joacaz chi' t'a Jehová, ix ab'chaj slesal winh chi', yujto ix yil Jehová tas wal tz'utaj heb' israel yuj winh sreyal Siria chi',
yuj chi' ix ak'ji jun mach skolwaj t'a heb' yuj Jehová chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yel heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sirio chi', ix kanxi heb' t'a junk'olal, ichataxon yajek' heb' t'a yalanhtaxo.

Palta maj yaktejkanlaj heb' sb'eyb'alan juntzanh chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam winh kuchb'annak heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal. Ix k'enhejcha'anh heb' yet' jun chukal chi', hanheja' ayek' jun yechel Asera t'a Samaria chi'.

Ha heb' soldado winhaj Joacaz chi', kenxonhej sb'isul heb', yujto a winh sreyal Siria ix satanel heb'. 50-xonhej heb' sk'e t'a yib'anh chej, lajunhe' carruaje yik owal yet' 10 mil soldado sb'ey t'a yok ayek'i.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj rey Joacaz yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Haxo yik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a Samaria. Ixlajwi chi', haxo winhaj Joás winh yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik 37 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Joás reyal t'a Judá, hata' ix scha'el yich winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Joacaz yak'an reyal t'a Israel, 16 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha juntzanh chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, a chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Joás chi', tastak ix sk'ulej winh yet' tas ix aj yak'an owal winh yet' winhaj Amasías sreyal Judá, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Joás chi', ix mukji winh t'a Samaria b'aj mukan juntzanhxo heb' winh sreyal Israel. Haxo winhaj Jeroboam ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.

Ayik manto cham winhaj Joás sreyal Israel chi', ix xit'ek' winh yil winhaj Eliseo ayik te pena'ay winhaj Eliseo chi' yuj jun yab'il ix ik'an schami. Yuj chi' ix ok'k'e winhaj Joás chi' t'a winh, ix och lak'naj winh t'a winh, ix yalan winh rey chi': --Ay mamin, lajan ach icha nok' chej yet' carruaje yik owal t'ayonh israel onh tik, yujto tzach kolwajnhej t'ayonh, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi': --Ik'kot junok a jul-lab' yet' jaye'ok sjul-lab'il, xchi winh. Ix yik'ankot winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi': --Jak wentena t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Ix sjakan winh rey chi', ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi': B'o'och a jul-lab' chi' yik ol ach julwajok, xchi winh. Yakb'an yamb'il te' yuj winh rey chi', ix yak'anoch sk'ab' winhaj Eliseo t'a yib'anh sk'ab' winh rey chi'. --Julwajanh an, xchi winh. Ix julwajb'at winh rey chi', ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi': --Ha a jul-lab' tik sch'oxanel skolwal Jehová t'a schonhab' to ol ak' ganar heb' sirio t'a Afec, ol a satanel heb' smasanil, xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh rey chi': --Yam juntzanh a jul-lab', xchi winh. Ayik ix syaman sjul-lab' winh chi', ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi': --Ha tikne'ik, tekub'tanhejem t'a sat lu'um, xchi winh. Yuj chi' oxel ix stekem winh rey chi', ix och wa'an winh.
Ix kot yowal winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yalan winh: --Oktom ix a tekem o'el wakelok, tato icha chi', icham chi' ol aj a satanel heb' sirio chi' smasanil. Okxo jun, oxelnhej ol ak' ganar heb', xchi winh.
Ix cham winhaj Eliseo chi', ix mukchaj winh. Junjun ab'il tzulnhejek' heb' moabita elk'al t'a yol smakb'en heb' israel.

Ha junel, ix b'at juntzanh heb' israel smuk jun chamnak. Ayik wan sk'och heb' b'aj ol smuk chi', ix yilan heb' sjawi heb' elk'um chi', toxonhej ix syumkanoch jun chamnak chi' heb' b'aj mukan winhaj Eliseo chi', ix b'at heb' elelal. Ayik ix och tennaj jun chamnak chi' t'a sb'akil winhaj Eliseo chi', ix pitzwixi, ix k'ex linhan.
Ix te ixtaj wal heb' israel yuj winhaj Hazael sreyal Siria ayik pitzanto winhaj rey Joacaz.

Palta ix yak' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a heb', ix ok' sk'ol t'a heb' yujnhej strato yet' winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob. Yuj chi' maj schalaj satji'el heb', maj yik'el-laj heb' t'a yichanh.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Hazael sreyal Siria chi', haxo winh yuninal winh skuchan Ben-adad ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.

Yuj chi', a winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Joacaz ix ik'anxikanek' juntzanh chonhab' ix yik'ek' winhaj Hazael t'a winhaj rey Joacaz ayik ix yak'an owal heb'. Oxel ix ak'ji ganar winhaj Ben-adad yuj winhaj Joás chi'. Icha chi' ix yutej winh skolanxikan juntzanh chonhab' chi'.
